Hello, I’m Nicky

Nicole Maria Pezza.
Nicky, for short.

Welcome to Frolicking Nicky, my personal travel journal and a home for my itineraries.

This is a space for exploring at a relaxed pace: food, wandering and everyday life alongside the things worth planning ahead.

You can follow the itineraries, borrow a few ideas, or use the checklists to make a trip your own. There’s room to leave things unticked.

Support local women

If you can afford to and would like to, consider supporting a women’s shelter in one of the places I visit.

I don’t receive any money or commission from these donations. Supporting local women matters to me, and this is one small way to give back to the places I visit. It takes all of us to stand against gender-based and domestic violence.
